source.note: 2000-01 Topps Premier Gold English Premier League soccer. TCDB lists a 124-card base set plus six foil insert/parallel checklists: Star Players in Silver/Gold/Blue and Superstars in Silver/Gold/Blue. VCS models each collector checklist separately.

decisions.canonicalPackFormat: Retail/display box configuration: 8 cards per pack, 36 packs per box.
decisions.baseStructure: Complete 124-card base checklist is one VCS Base ProductSet.
decisions.insertStructure: Star Players is modeled as three 20-card foil color ProductSets; Superstars is modeled as three 4-card foil color ProductSets, matching TCDB's six collector checklists.
decisions.foilOdds: Contemporary sealed-product descriptions report one foil insert per pack and color mixes around Silver/Gold/Blue, while TCDB trivia gives a slightly different color split and labels it as a parallel mix rather than straightforward pack odds. Because VCS oddsPerPack is one integer per ProductSet and cannot represent a conditional color distribution cleanly, no color-specific pack odds are guessed; all six foil ProductSets remain null pending a trustworthy directly translatable pack-odds source.
decisions.trueRookieNaming: Base RC suffixes are added only for card numbers returned by TCDB's linked rookie index. Insert names do not infer rookie status.
decisions.cleanPlayerNames: Player contains the clean subject name plus verified RC and short conventional collector abbreviations only. Long source descriptions, errors, variations, odds, or other metadata are kept out of Player.
decisions.releaseSafety: Product remains unreleased until pricing and images are reviewed.
